summary:
Comprehensive production surgical plan for MaxPlay APK covering:
1. Custom APK & PWA App Icon setup using the exact user-provided image without modification.
2. Root-cause fix for Server 2 downloads (preserving embed Referer/Origin headers across CDN segment fetches + full Server 2 URL extraction).
3. Real Speech-to-Text Voice Search on the Search Screen with a single purple-gradient circular button and white Mic icon.
4. Static single-line horizontal layout for Audio, Quality, and Season selector boxes on Series/Anime Details Screens, plus reliable Server 2 multi-language detection and live "Your quality is switching..." status feedback below the player spinner.
5. Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode fix so only the video player enters PiP instead of shrinking the entire Details Screen.
6. Popunder Ad protection (strictly max 2 popunders per Details Screen visit, only after a 10-minute grace period, and back-button history shield so users return to the Player/Details Screen instead of exiting the app).
7. Native Android System Push Notifications for Me > Messages inbox updates.
8. Universal Hardware Back Button (Triangle button) navigation stack fix across Me > Settings, Downloads > Offline Player, Modals, and Fullscreen.
9. Downloads Screen Transfer (.maxplay P2P/Share format with live status indicators), Local Files scanner/importer, Received Files tab, aligned Available Storage badge, and real catalog For You Recommendations with working Refresh button.
10. Multi-device responsive player control bar fix so the Fullscreen button never overflows off-screen on compact phones.
11. Home Screen top-right Arrow APK Update Checker (blinking red alert when admin version > installed version, update modal, and Admin Force-Update / Old Version Service Lock).
